races.title: State House, District 41
races.note: Unopposed: this seat was decided without a general-election contest, so it won't be on your ballot.

cands.name: Bruce Antone
cands.bio: Orlando Democrat, born 1960. Florida House member 2002-06, 2012-20 and since 2022. Electrical engineering degree from Tuskegee; earlier legislative aide and chief of staff to then-Sen. Buddy Dyer (1992-99). Unopposed on the Nov. 3 ballot.

record.text: Served in the Florida House for HD 39 (2002-06), HD 46 (2012-20) and HD 41 (since Nov. 2022), per Wikipedia.
Joined Fentrice Driskell in calling mid-decade redistricting "foolish" and unconstitutional (per Florida Politics headline).

controversies.text: A 2024 WUSF/Fresh Take Florida report found his voter registration and some filings listed addresses in HD 40 or elsewhere outside HD 41 (he owns a home in HD 40). He said he forgot to update records and changed his address after reporter questions in Jan. 2024. The report found no charges or House ruling; it said the facts raise questions about eligibility.

cands.gaps: No campaign website, donor reporting or endorsement list found. What happened after April 2024 on the residency question is not verified. Owner sources: one combined web search (name plus the owner-source domains) returned no hits on any of them, but the search tool did not honor the site: filter, so coverage is incomplete; alexjoneslive.com on-site search also returned no results.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
